card.name: Partway through neurotransmitter and hormone terms
card.fires_on: The ending of words inside neurotransmitter or signalling-molecule phrases, such as -ic in adrenergic, -HT in 5-HT, or -ogenous in endogenous, and linking words just before these molecules. It appears in drug-interaction text on serotonin, norepinephrine and bradykinin.

modes.label: Word endings in transmitter terms
modes.description: The last piece of a long word like adrenergic, endogenous or 5-HT that leads into a signalling molecule.
modes.example: from adrenerg<<ic>> nerve endings causing headaches

modes.label: Linking word before a molecule
modes.description: A small word such as "of" or "serotonin" right before a list of signalling molecules or reuptake terms.
modes.example: affect the metabolism<< of>> eicosanoids and polypeptides

card.writes: It seems to favor words like release, released and factor, as in "releasing factor", and to disfavor words like cyclic.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of words for body chemical messengers like adrenergic, serotonin and bradykinin, when the text is about drug interactions.
